description: This file implements a stateless rate limiter with adaptive exponential backoff, including circuit breaker functionality and error detection for rate limit errors, designed for use across distributed containers.

classes.name: RateLimitError
classes.description: Custom exception representing rate limit errors, optionally carrying a retry-after interval.

classes.name: StatelessRateLimiter
classes.description: A class providing rate limiting with exponential backoff, jitter, and circuit breaker logic, suitable for distributed environments.

methods.name: int _get_container_seed(self)
methods.description: Generate a container-specific seed for consistent jitter distribution based on hostname and process ID.

methods.name: bool _is_rate_limit_error(self, error: Exception)
methods.description: Determine if an exception is related to rate limiting based on class, message, or status code.

methods.name: Optional[float] _extract_retry_after(self, error: Exception)
methods.description: Extract retry-after duration from error responses or attributes.

methods.name: float _calculate_backoff_delay( self, attempt: int, retry_after: Optional[float] = None )
methods.description: Compute delay using exponential backoff with container-specific jitter, optionally using server-specified retry-after.

methods.name: bool _check_circuit_breaker(self)
methods.description: Return whether the circuit breaker is currently open, based on timeout.

methods.name: _update_circuit_breaker(self, success: bool)
methods.description: Update the state of the circuit breaker based on success or failure of an attempt.

methods.name: Any execute_with_retry(self, func, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously execute a given function with retries, respecting rate limit errors, jitter, and circuit breaker conditions.
